title: Ivo and the Spire
author: Rafael Reyes
blurb: Lior Voss, a bone-carver who hears the dead, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
